# `{upxdvir}` - Font Customisation

There are 2 ways to choose the font faces used by the typesetting.

1. Presets from `{pxchfon}`
1. Locally installed fonts

How is a font chosen?

<!-- TODO: Fill this section out. -->

## Presets from `{pxchfon}`

Presets such as the following are supported:

1. `ipa`
1. `ipaex`
1. `haranoaji`
1. `sourcehan`


```{r setup, echo = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(error = TRUE)
drawGrid <- function(border = TRUE) {
    if (border) {
        grid.rect(gp = gpar(lwd = 10, col = 2))
    }
    grid.segments(
        c(0, .5),
        c(.5, 0),
        c(1, .5),
        c(.5, 1),
        gp = gpar(lty = 4, col = "gray", alpha = .5)
    )
}
```


```{r fonts2, fig.align = "center", fig.height = 4, fig.width = 4}
drawGrid()
grid.uplatex("これはIPAフォントです。",
    x = .1,
    gp = gpar(fontfamily = "ipa")
)
grid.uplatex("これはIPAexフォントです。",
    x = .3,
    gp = gpar(fontfamily = "ipaex")
)
grid.uplatex("これはHaranoAjiフォントです。",
    x = .5,
    gp = gpar(fontfamily = "haranoaji")
)
grid.uplatex("これはSourceHanフォントです。",
    x = .7,
    gp = gpar(fontfamily = "sourcehan")
)
grid.uplatex("デフォルトのフォント。", x = .9)
```

## Locally Installed Fonts

In order to use locally installed fonts, they must be searchable by a `kpsewhich` lookup.
The specified font face will determine where the font will apply.

For example, specifying `fontfamily = "NotoSansCJKjp-Regular.otf"` with `fontface = "serif"` will apply the font to the Serif face.

```{r}
grid.uplatex(
    "これは Noto Sans フォントです。", x = .25)
grid.uplatex(
    "これは Noto Sans フォントです。",
    gp = gpar(fontfamily = "SourceHanSans-Bold.otf", face = "bold")
)
```
